es: Integrar obligación, prohibición, lenguaje reglamentario, razón y excepciones para redactar una normativa breve y un aviso cercano que la explique a los vecinos.

teaching.en: This policy sets the rules for using the shared garden.
teaching.es: Esta normativa fija las reglas para usar el huerto compartido.
teaching.explanationEs: Policy: el documento que reúne las normas; se redacta en presente formal (sets, covers).
teaching.audioText: This policy sets the rules for using the shared garden.

teaching.en: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds.
teaching.es: Cada socio mantendrá su parcela libre de malas hierbas.
teaching.explanationEs: Each + singular + shall + verbo base: obligación formal y directa; each no lleva -s.
teaching.audioText: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds.

teaching.en: Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use.
teaching.es: Las herramientas se limpiarán y se devolverán al cobertizo después de usarse.
teaching.explanationEs: Are to be + participio: orden impersonal de reglamento.
segments: Tools are to be cleaned and
returned to the shed after use.
teaching.audioText: Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use.

teaching.en: Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly.
teaching.es: Se podrá llevar compost a casa, siempre que se reparta de forma justa.
teaching.explanationEs: May be + participio con una condición: permiso formal con límite.
segments: Compost may be taken home, provided
teaching.audioText: Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly.

teaching.en: The committee has the paths cleaned by a company, but each member is responsible for their own plot.
teaching.es: El comité hace limpiar los caminos a una empresa, pero cada socio es responsable de su parcela.
teaching.explanationEs: Have + objeto + participio: se encarga a un tercero. Responsible for: quien responde de la tarea.
segments: The committee has the paths cleaned by a company,
but each member is responsible for their own plot.
teaching.audioText: The committee has the paths cleaned by a company, but each member is responsible for their own plot.

teaching.en: Dear neighbours, this notice explains why the garden will be closed on Mondays.
teaching.es: Estimados vecinos, este aviso explica por qué el huerto cerrará los lunes.
teaching.explanationEs: Un aviso abre con el destinatario y da pronto el motivo, en tono cercano.
segments: Dear neighbours, this notice explains why the
garden will be closed on Mondays.
teaching.audioText: Dear neighbours, this notice explains why the garden will be closed on Mondays.

prompt.es: Elige la versión formal de la regla para una normativa.

choices.text: Each member will keep the shed locked, OK?
Every member keeps to lock the shed.
Each member shall keep the shed locked.

feedback.es: Each member shall + verbo base es la fórmula de obligación de una normativa; las otras dos son informales o incorrectas.

hint.es: Busca el modal formal y el sujeto en singular.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los socios son responsables de regar su propia parcela.»

feedback.es: Responsible for + -ing indica quién responde de una tarea.

hint.es: Es el adjetivo que significa «responsable» y se une a for.

origin.text: Members are ___ for watering their own plots.

prompt.es: Ordena: «Estimados vecinos, les escribimos para informarles del cambio.»

answer.text: Dear neighbours, we are writing to inform you of the change

feedback.es: El aviso abre con el destinatario y expresa la finalidad con to + verbo: to inform.

hint.es: Tras el saludo, la finalidad va con to + verbo.

prompt.es: Relaciona cada frase con su tono o su función.

pairs: Tools are to be returned to the shed.
Please return the tools to the shed.
Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain…
Each member shall pay a small fee.

feedback.es: Are to be es formal y please suena cercano; Dear neighbours abre un aviso y shall fija la obligación.

pairs: Tools are to be returned to the shed.
Please return the tools to the shed.
Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain…
Each member shall pay a small fee.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué cerrarán el huerto los lunes.

feedback.es: La razón del cierre es que la tierra necesita descansar; los socios aún pueden recoger herramientas con permiso.

origin.audio: Good evening, neighbours. From next month, the garden will be closed on Mondays, because the soil needs to rest. Members may still collect their tools, provided that they ask the rota manager first.

prompt.es: Completa: «Estimados vecinos, este aviso explica por qué cambia la normativa.»

feedback.es: Un notice es el aviso público que informa a los vecinos.

origin.text: Dear neighbours, this ___ explains why the policy is changing.

feedback.es: Don't have to marca lo que no es obligatorio: regar en otros días; el día del turno y devolver las herramientas son obligaciones.

origin.text: Garden rules: You are required to water on your rota day and to return the tools. You don't have to water on other days.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige cuál es la razón de la nueva normativa.

choices.text: To raise the price of plots.
To give large families more space.

feedback.es: La razón es la justicia: como la lista de espera es larga, se limita una parcela por familia.

origin.audio: Ms Ortiz, from the garden committee: Our rationale is simple: plots should be shared fairly. The waiting list is long, so the new policy limits each family to one plot. Mr Bell, a member: I understand the aim, but the impact on large families will be serious.

prompt.es: Completa: «Los perros no podrán entrar, salvo los perros guía.»

feedback.es: Except for (o apart from) + nombre introduce la excepción a la prohibición.

origin.text: Dogs may not enter the garden, ___ guide dogs.

prompt.es: Escribe una normativa breve y un aviso para los vecinos.

answer.text: Policy: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds. Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use. Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly. Dogs may not enter the garden, except for guide dogs. Notice: Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain the new garden policy. The rules are intended to keep the garden nice for everybody, given that many families share it. Each member is responsible for watering on their rota day, but you don't have to work on other days. In order to keep the tools safe, please return them to the shed. If you have any questions, please speak to the committee on Saturday morning.
accepted: Policy: Each member shall keep their plot free of weeds. Tools are to be cleaned and returned to the shed after use. Compost may be taken home, provided that it is shared fairly. Dogs may not enter the garden, except for guide dogs. Notice: Dear neighbours, we are writing to explain the new garden policy. The rules are intended to keep the garden nice for everybody, given that many families share it. Each member is responsible for watering on their rota day, but you don't have to work on other days. In order to keep the tools safe, please return them to the shed. If you have any questions, please speak to the committee on Saturday morning.

Policy: Every member shall pay a small fee each year. Plots must be kept tidy, and weeds are to be removed every week. Fires may not be lit in the garden, apart from the barbecue area. Notice: Dear neighbours, from May the garden has a new policy. Its rationale is fairness, since a long waiting list means that nobody should leave a plot empty. Members are required to tell the committee if they cannot look after their plot. You are permitted to bring friends on Sundays, provided that they follow the rules. Thank you for your help.

feedback.es: Un buen texto separa dos registros: normas formales e impersonales y un aviso cercano que saluda, da la razón y dice a quién acudir.

origin.text: Eres secretario o secretaria del comité de un huerto comunitario. Escribe en inglés, en un solo texto de 100 a 170 palabras: (1) varias normas formales (shall, may not, are to be) con una excepción o condición y (2) un aviso cercano para los vecinos (Dear neighbours) que explique la razón de la normativa.

prompt.es: Elige cómo se prohíbe en tono oficial dejar bolsos en el pasillo.

choices.text: Bags may not be left in the corridor.
Bags don't leave in the corridor.
Bags shall leave in the corridor.

feedback.es: May not be left es la prohibición formal en pasiva; las otras dos no forman una norma correcta.

origin.text: Informal notice: Don't leave your bags in the corridor.

prompt.es: Escucha y elige por qué se cerrará el cobertizo.

choices.text: Because the shed is being repaired.
Because nobody uses it after six.

feedback.es: Given that some tools went missing explica la razón: se perdieron herramientas el mes pasado.

origin.audio: Dear neighbours, the tool shed will be locked at six, given that some tools went missing last month. In order to borrow a tool after six, please ask the garden manager.

prompt.es: Escribe una frase amable pidiendo no regar después de mediodía.

answer.text: We kindly ask neighbours not to water the plots after noon.
accepted: We kindly ask neighbours not to water the plots after noon.
Please do not water the plots after noon.
Neighbours are kindly asked not to water after noon.

feedback.es: We ask… not to + verbo convierte una prohibición formal en una petición cercana.

origin.text: Escribe una frase de aviso amable: pedir a los vecinos que no rieguen las parcelas después de mediodía.
